P01.drivers: Average proportions, normal shoulder-to-hip ratio, ordinary S-curve spine in profile, standard limb lengths

P02.drivers: Ordinary human body with mild belly projection in profile; proportions otherwise typical

P03.drivers: Soft, somewhat heavier body with belly projection in profile, but structure and proportions remain ordinary human

P04.drivers: Trunk is a near-rectangular block: very wide waist with almost no taper, flat slab-like front and back planes in profile, low crotch, thick column legs with little knee/calf articulation, wide-set feet; reads as a differently organized stocky body rather than just a heavy human
axial_cues: low crotch / long trunk relative to legs
limb_cues: thick arms with little elbow taper

P05.drivers: Narrow shoulders and pelvis with long arms reaching well down the thigh; profile shows a strong rounded upper-back/chest mass over a pinched waist and a pronounced forward knee/calf bulge, giving a lean, sinuous S-shaped organization unlike the human set
axial_cues: rounded upper back hump in profile

P06.drivers: Typical human proportions, slightly broader shoulders, normal profile

P07.drivers: Ordinary human proportions with normal shoulder/hip relation

P08.drivers: Same block-trunk organization as P04: wide barrel trunk with flat back and no waist, low crotch, short thick legs with weak joint articulation; belly mass alone does not explain the slab-like section shape

P09.drivers: Ordinary human proportions, normal profile curvature

P10.drivers: Matches P05: narrow pelvis, thin waist, long arms with large hands, profile with rounded upper-back mass and forward-bulging knee/calf, sinuous lean organization

P12.drivers: Slender ordinary human body, normal profile

groups.label: block-trunk stocky bodies (flat back, no waist, columnar limbs)
lean sinuous bodies (narrow pelvis, long arms, upper-back mass, forward knee bulge)

distinguishing_features: P04/P08 have a wide rectangular trunk with flat front/back planes, no waist taper, low crotch and thick weakly-articulated limbs, upright. P05/P10 are the opposite: narrow pelvis and waist, rounded upper-back/chest mass in profile, long arms with large hands, and a forward knee/calf bulge giving a slightly flexed, S-curved posture.
